实验性，效果可能不如单模型: Experimental; results may be worse than a single model
普通单模型识别不需要使用: Not needed for ordinary single-model recognition
CTranslate2 版 Whisper，支持日语/英语、词级时间戳和可选后端: CTranslate2 Whisper with Japanese and English recognition, word timestamps and optional native VAD. English projects select this backend and exclude Japanese-only Kotoba models.
MiMo-V2.5-TTS 支持预置音色、文字设计音色和参考音频克隆。选择 vo: MiMo-V2.5-TTS supports preset voices, voice design from text and reference audio cloning. Voiceclone uses project or external reference audio without a reference transcript.
使用 MiniMax 同步语音合成接口。音色 ID 可填写系统音色，也可填写账号: Uses the MiniMax synchronous speech API. Enter a system voice ID or a cloned or designed voice already created in your account.
多语言零样本音色克隆，支持独立情绪参考、文字情绪、八维情绪向量、时长控制和发音标: Multilingual zero-shot voice cloning with separate emotion references, emotion text, eight-dimensional emotion vectors, duration control and pronunciation marks. Loaded models and reference conditions are reused across sentences.
日本语料蒸馏的 Whisper，适合作为 Parakeet 的质量复核模型。: Whisper distilled on Japanese speech, suitable for reviewing Parakeet results.
连接兼容 /v1/audio/speech 的语音合成服务。适合不使用参考音频的: Connects to speech services compatible with /v1/audio/speech. Suitable for cloud voices without reference audio. Model, voice and extra request parameters are customizable.
连接兼容 /v1/audio/transcriptions 的语音识别服务。上传: Connects to recognition services compatible with /v1/audio/transcriptions, uploading audio and reading segments from verbose_json. Model ID and extra request parameters are customizable.
连接官方 FastAPI runtime。零样本模式使用参考音频+文本；跨语言模: Connects to the official FastAPI runtime. Zero-shot mode uses reference audio and text; cross-language mode uses audio alone with different voice and prosody constraints.
连接官方 api_v2.py 的 /tts 接口。参考音频路径必须是服务端可见路: Connects to /tts in the official api_v2.py. Reference audio paths must be accessible to the server. Docker and remote services need mounted or mapped paths.
通过 /v1/tts 调用远程 IndexTTS2。程序以 multipart: Calls remote IndexTTS2 through /v1/tts, sending voice and optional emotion references as multipart files. The service can return audio, Base64 or an audio URL.
零样本音色克隆，可把音色参考和情绪控制分开。音色参考不要求转写；可用文本情绪或情: Zero-shot voice cloning with separate voice references and emotion controls. Voice references need no transcript. Emotion text or vectors are supported; random sampling reduces cloning consistency.
面向 Fish Speech 自建 OpenAPI 或 Fish Audio 兼: Connects to self-hosted Fish Speech or Fish Audio compatible services using /v1/tts with references containing audio and text. APIs vary between releases.
已将 {provider} 的 API Key 以便携式明文保存在程序目录中；删: The {provider} API key is saved as plain text in the portable folder and is removed with that folder.
当前服务尚未保存 API Key。: No API key saved for this service.
当前服务可不填写 API Key；如服务端要求认证，也可以保存。: An API key is optional; save one if the server requires authentication.
运行环境未安装。请在“设备与模型”中安装 IndexTTS-2.5。: Runtime not installed. Download IndexTTS-2.5 on the Models page.
运行环境未安装。请在“设备与模型”中安装 IndexTTS2。: Runtime not installed. Download IndexTTS2 on the Models page.
运行环境已安装，但模型不完整：缺少 {files}。: Runtime installed, but model files are missing: {files}.
分离环境：已安装（点击“检查环境和模型”确认可用）: Separation runtime installed; use diagnostics to verify availability.
分离环境：未安装（点击“安装分离环境”，首次约下载数 GB）: Separation runtime not installed; the first download requires several GB.
按对应源语言句子校准中文响度（不移动或修改原音频）: Matching dubbing loudness to each source sentence; source audio is preserved.
正在把中文克隆音轨加入原音轨，并执行最终峰值保护: Mixing dubbed speech with source audio and applying peak protection.
IndexTTS2 独立环境批量生成 {count} 句: IndexTTS2 generating {count} sentences in its separate runtime
操作已取消；已经完成并保存的内容会保留。: Cancelled; completed and saved results are retained.
项目已建立，音频语言为{language}。可以开始识别。: Project created with {language} audio. Recognition can start.
翻译完成。请检查中文后保存表格。: Translation completed. Review and save the sentence table.
未发现 ZIP。把模型包原样放入该目录后再扫描。: No ZIP files found. Place model packages here and scan again.
